Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1361
Claimant:
Cynthia Steele
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
9-17-23
The claimant reported a sideswipe while changing lanes and described a knee injury from the impact. The claim was
opened and the file assigned for review.
9-18-23
Photos taken at the scene confirm several details of the reported damage to the side panels. No independent
witnesses have come forward, so the photos are the main visual record at this stage.
10-20-23
The damage to the vehicle is mostly in line with the impact described by the claimant. No earlier damage to the
vehicle is known, and nothing suggests the damage happened before the coverage started.
11-14-23
The driver is named on the policy. Police records and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of
the incident.
2-28-24
The claimant gave the same account in every conversation so far. The knee injury is plausible for a collision of this
type, and no earlier injury to the same body area is known.
4-14-24
Medical treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the claimant improved. The claimant is not represented
by a lawyer and has been dealing with the claim directly.
5-9-24
Based on the photos, the vehicle damage, the mediacl course and the consistent account, the claim appears
consistent with the reported incident and remains open pending final review of the medical and repair records.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
